newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Slow Bahrain shares end quieter week static.
newsitem.headline: Slow Bahrain shares end quieter week static.

text.p: Shares on Bahrain's stock market ended the week to Thursday little changed in lower-volume trade, the Bahrain Stock Exchange (BSE) said.
The index ended flat at 1,584.95 points compared with 1,584.46 points the previous week.

Around 7.6 million shares worth 1.67 dinars ($4.4 million) were traded this week, down from 11.9 million shares worth 2.2 million dinars a week earlier. Shares of 23 of the 39 firms listed in the exchange changed hands in 206 transactions.
Bahrain Middle East Bank led the market with 2.76 million shares worth 303,775 dinars changing hands. Its shares ended the week at 109 fils each, up one fil on a week earlier.
The bourse said 704,526 shares of Investcorp worth 467,712 dinars were dealt. Its shares closed on Thursday at $1.76 each, down one U.S. cent from a week earlier.
Bahrain's share market is open to nationals of the six Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
